Company Description

Do you enjoy turning financial insight into commercial impact? Join Deloitte’s Nordic Sales Excellence Team to develop compelling pricing strategies and commercial solutions that deliver value for clients and strengthen profitability. This is an exciting opportunity to help increase the win rate and shape commercial decisions for Deloitte’s largest and most important deals.

With more than 8,000 employees, Deloitte is one of the largest professional services firms across the Nordics. We help clients navigate complex business and technology transformations by combining deep industry expertise with leading capabilities in Audit, Tax, Advisory, and Consulting.

Join our diverse Nordic Technology & Transformation Sales Excellence team and help shape Deloitte’s most strategic pursuits. The team helps win deals and improve profitability through compelling pricing and commercial propositions for our clients. We provide expert advice on all commercial aspects of client proposals, focusing primarily on higher-value, more complex deals and Deloitte’s most important Nordic clients.

This role can be placed either in Copenhagen, Denmark or in Oslo, Norway.

Job Description

What will be your role?

We aim to become the largest professional services firm in the Nordics by continuously innovating, evolving and adapting to meet clients’ needs. To achieve this, we need to strengthen our commercial expertise to support our most complex deals, to our most important clients. You will play a key role in our Nordic Sales Excellence team, and your worksite is therefore flexible within the Nordics.

As our Commercial and Pricing Specialist, your role will be to structure and shape commercial solutions to respond to our client’s requirements and challenges and to help win business and improve profitability. You will work closely with the rest of the Nordic Sales Excellence Team and the stakeholders for our major Nordic accounts to shape commercial arrangements.

The core responsibilities of your role include:

• Shape commercial solutions for complex opportunities, bringing together clients’ needs, pricing options and commercial considerations into compelling proposals

• Develop pricing strategies and structures that demonstrate value to clients and improve our ability to win work

• Build and challenge deal economics through financial modelling, testing margins, assumptions, pricing scenarios and commercial risks

• Partner with proposal teams to design and implement commercial strategies that grow revenue and strengthen profitability

• Advance value-based pricing by helping pursuit teams identify and quantify expected clients’ outcomes, then translate them into appropriate pricing models

• Support proposals and negotiations by clearly articulating the pricing structure and commercial assumptions, and advising on terms and trade-offs

• Build commercial capability across the Nordics through practical guidance, training, knowledge sharing and improvements to the various tools and ways of working

Qualifications

Who are we looking for?

You are a commercially minded professional with strong analytical and modelling skills, together with good business acumen. We are looking for a team player with a collegiate style who enjoys working, collaborating and having fun with team-mates.

We imagine that you have:

• A minimum of 5 years’ experience in pricing, commercial finance, deal shaping or a related commercial role; professional-services experience is an advantage

• A strong financial modelling and Excel skills, with the ability to turn analysis into clear recommendations

• Experience with leveraging AI applications in commercial work, with the judgement to evaluate outputs

• Confidence working with senior stakeholders and collaborating across functions and countries

• Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain pricing choices and commercial terms

• It would be desirable, but not essential, to have professional services experience and insights, ideally having worked within a consulting or professional service organisation

• Flexibility to meet peaks of work inherent in the cycle of a deal

• Proficient in written and spoken English. Knowledge of another Scandinavian language is a benefit

Work permit: We are only able to consider applicants with a valid work permit in Denmark/Norway.

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

What impact will your role make?

Every day, your work will make an impact that matters, while you thrive in a dynamic culture of inclusion, collaboration and high performance. We do not just aspire to make solutions. We wish to create an impact that makes a positive and crucial difference for the people around us, our clients and our society. Deloitte is where you’ll find unlimited opportunities to succeed and realize your full potential.

jobs.occupation: Senior Data Engineer – Build the Data Foundation for Greener Rail
jobs.description:
Cubris · A Hitachi Rail company · Ballerup, Denmark · On-site with flexibility

Would you like to use your expertise in Python, geospatial data and data platforms to make rail operations smarter and more energy-efficient? At Cubris, you will play a central role in developing the data foundation behind solutions that help train operators reduce energy consumption and improve punctuality.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer who enjoys shaping technical direction, building solutions and working closely with colleagues across engineering, architecture and product.

Your role

You will help shape the data platform and geospatial model supporting our GreenSpeed® platform and Infrastructure Management System. You will turn complex railway data into a consistent, reliable foundation for our software – covering everything from tracks, signals and stations to gradients, speed limits and temporary restrictions.

Your main responsibilities will be to:

• 
Develop our data platform and geospatial model: Define schemas, feature classes, linear referencing using track and chainage, topology rules and railway asset attributes.

• 
Build robust Python data pipelines: Ingest, transform and integrate data, and automate workflows using Airflow or similar orchestration tools.

• 
Develop spatial storage and cloud solutions: Work with PostgreSQL/PostGIS or equivalent technologies, preferably on Microsoft Azure, and apply graph-based structures where they add value.

• 
Ensure data quality and traceability: Validate geometries, topology and attributes, and document data models and workflows with appropriate versioning and change control.

• 
Translate requirements into practical solutions: Collaborate with architects, software engineers, product managers and DevOps to deliver solutions that meet today’s needs and evolve with our products.

What you bring

You have substantial hands-on experience in data platform development and architecture, and you enjoy both making technical decisions and implementing them.

We are particularly interested in your:

• 
Strong Python skills and experience with scalable data pipelines, data integration and orchestration tools such as Airflow.

• 
Experience with GeoPandas, Shapely, GDAL/OGR, PyProj or equivalent geospatial technologies, including LineString and MultiLineString geometries.

• 
Knowledge of PostgreSQL/PostGIS or other spatial databases.

• 
Experience developing cloud-native data solutions, preferably on Microsoft Azure.

• 
Ability to work independently when requirements are evolving and documentation is still taking shape.

We also welcome a strong engineering grounding in industrial systems. You may have developed this through your education or through experience in transport, manufacturing, energy or automation. You understand how software, data and physical infrastructure interact, and how to translate real-world assets and operating conditions into accurate data models. You also appreciate the demands for quality, reliability and traceability in systems used in daily operations.

Experience with QGIS or ArcGIS, graph-based data structures and algorithms, safety-critical systems, railway technology or EBuLa integration would be an advantage.

As a colleague, you share your knowledge, contribute ideas and enjoy solving problems with others. You can balance long-term technical quality with practical delivery.

Why join Cubris?

You will have a real say in technical decisions and product development in a company where ideas can quickly become action. Our flat, agile organisation encourages open dialogue and gives you room to take ownership.

You will join a small, autonomous team backed by Hitachi Rail’s international expertise and resources. Your work will serve a clear purpose: smarter rail operations with lower energy consumption and CO₂ emissions.

The role is based in Ballerup, Denmark. We value close collaboration in the office while offering flexibility.

About Cubris

Cubris is a Danish software company and has been part of Hitachi Rail since 2024. Our award-winning GreenSpeed® platform helps train operators optimise driving, reduce energy consumption and improve punctuality. We develop technology for Driver Advisory Systems (DAS), Automatic Train Operation (ATO) and advanced data analytics.

Interested in joining us?

We would love to hear about your experience, your ideas and what motivates you. Send us your application and CV, or get in touch if you would like to learn more about the role and life at Cubris.

Optical Design Engineers for our High Power Beam Combining team

Location: Farum, Denmark | Level: PhD / Postdoc / Experienced Engineer

The Mission: Build the Next Generation of SBC Systems

At Ibsen Photonics, we are developing Spectral Beam Combining (SBC) modules for high-power laser architectures. We are looking for creative, hands-on Optical Design Engineers to take full ownership of designing, building, and optimising our SBC platform.

This role bridges the gap between theoretical physics and industrial reality. You won’t just design on a screen; you will spend significant time in the lab, iterating rapidly from proof-of-concept to robust, production-ready, scalable systems.

Key responsibilities:

• Design & Assemble: Develop compact, efficient SBC modules using Ibsen’s world-class transmission gratings, while considering optical beam paths, thermal effects and mechanical constraints.

• System Optimisation: Drive performance by refining optical alignment, mechanical stability, and complex thermal management for high-power loads in a reiterative process: design – experiment – optimise.

• Characterisation: Use advanced diagnostics to maintain beam quality (low M²) during power scaling, including wavefront sensing and spectral analysis.

• Full Lifecycle Ownership: Source optical/mechanical components and manage the transition from experimental prototypes to scalable, volume-ready designs.

• Global Collaboration: Work closely with an internal team and international partners, including potential overseas visits for joint prototyping and testing.

What you bring

You are a proactive problem-solver who thrives in a “build-test-learn” environment. Ideally, you possess:

• Education: A PhD or Postdoc in Optics, Photonics, Laser Physics, or a related field.

• Expertise:

• Hands on experience with (high-power) fibre and free-space optical systems, precise alignment, and experimental troubleshooting.

• Understanding of (and ideally experience with) SBC and CBC beam combining techniques.

• Beam quality measurement and analysis.

• Mechanical design of low-tolerance devices

• Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Gaussian optics, beam propagation, and high-power laser effects (thermal lensing, runaway-effects, mitigation strategies).

• Software Skills: Proficiency in optical simulation tools (e.g., Zemax) and familiarity with mechanical CAD.

• Mindset: Independent enough to drive a project and work on your own, but collaborative enough to thrive in a flat-hierarchy, cross-functional team, sharing insights and discussing projects/next steps. The role is highly experimental and hands-on, requiring independence and a strong drive to make systems work in practice, not just on paper.

• Security Clearance: You are a European citizen with no family ties to Russia or Russian allied territories, and you have a clean criminal record.

Why join Ibsen Photonics?

• High Impact: Your designs will directly shape the future of high-brightness laser systems for manufacturing, defence, telecommunications, and science.

• Freedom to Innovate: We value experimental drive—if you have a better way to align or stabilise a system, we want to see it.

• Danish Engineering Culture: Enjoy a supportive environment with fast decision-making, real ownership, and a healthy work-life balance.

• Significant experience in commercial finance, business development, M&A finance, financial system change projects or customer profitability, including cross-country, regional or global exposure.

**

**You will be the finance partner who helps Region Europe and Canada decide where to invest in online partnerships and consumer initiatives, and who shows what those investments deliver.

• Develop and deliver a business case methodology across European markets, so investment decisions are prudent, comparable and grounded in facts as part of the business rhythm.

Working across markets, you will help drive both the online sales agenda and the consumer finance agenda in Obesity.

The role is based in Ørestad, Copenhagen, Denmark.

jobs.occupation: DCS Automation Specialist – ABB 800xA for Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
DCS Automation Specialist – ABB 800xA for Novo Nordisk Engineering

Do you want to be a part of NNE’s all-time largest Process Automation team? We are looking for a colleague to join our fantastic company, where we have the aspiration of becoming best in class within Automation Solutions for Pharmaceutical Engineering.

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

Imagine seeing your automation solutions come to life in pharma facilities that are essential for millions of patients. In our DCS Automation team, deep DCS expertise meets real process understanding – and you'll be at the centre of it.

Why you'll enjoy working here:

• Greenfield projects at scale: An exciting pipeline of large, data-driven greenfield plants with modular, scalable designs.

• The full automation lifecycle: Consultancy, design and development, implementation and validation of automation solutions for the pharma and biotech industries.

• Real process depth: Work across API production areas such as fermentation, recovery and purification, utility and cleaning systems.

• Room to innovate: Our solutions are built on a deep understanding of our customers' production processes – and when standard components can't do the job, we develop our own.

• A strong professional community: 80+ DCS Automation colleagues in Denmark and 200+ globally, from graduate engineers to senior specialists and leads.

How you might spend your days

As a DCS Application Specialist, you'll join a diverse, collaborative team where no two days look the same. You will:

• Shape the control systems. Design, develop, implement, qualify and support Process Control Systems, using your deep PCS/DCS expertise and your hands-on feel for how client plants really run.

• Stand side by side with the client. Work closely with the client's Operational Responsible and operators, from the first design discussions through to commissioning.

• Solve problems where code meets equipment. Track down and resolve whatever shows up when the software meets the physical plant.

• Fine-tune to the finish line. Optimise the processes until they are ready for final handover.

• Connect with experts across disciplines. Exchange ideas with process experts and colleagues who specialise in MES, historian systems, instruments, production equipment and more.

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Respectful of your colleagues’ individual and cultural differences

• Aware of your surroundings and able to flag any concerns

• Agile and able to prioritize urgent tasks

• Team-oriented and able to collaborate on team projects

• Reliable, curious and eager to learn

• Appreciative of feedback, because it contributes to your growth

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• Engineering foundation: A degree in electrical, automation, process or marine engineering – or equivalent experience

• Hands-on DCS skills: Proven experience designing and coding PCS/DCS applications, ideally in ABB 800xA or ABB SattLine

• Batch know-how: Understanding of batch production and ISA-88 – or a strong drive to build it quickly

• Regulated or project experience: Experience from GMP/GAMP environments or from executing automation projects – and you find the complexity of GMP/GAMP meaningful

• Cross-disciplinary mindset: You collaborate easily with process experts and colleagues working on MES, Historian, instrumentation and production equipment

• Digital and AI-savvy: You use AI tools, scripting (e.g. Python) and smart engineering tools to work faster, standardise and reuse solutions

• Future-oriented: You are motivated by modular, data-driven and scalable automation design

Why choose NNE?

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 14th December 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Please contact Manager Ditte Høiberg Møller on +45 3075 5028 or Manager Volker J. Jentzsch on +45 3191 1540.

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

Connected Cars is on an ambitious mission to connect millions of vehicles through real-time data, enabling safer and more sustainable mobility. Our team of ~70 people is driven by a shared belief in community, team effort, and quality solutions.

The Position

As we rapidly scale across international markets, we are looking for a Head of Support & Training. Exceptional support and structured customer training are core drivers of our product adoption. Sitting within the Commercial team, you will lead a dedicated technical product support team of 5, act as a proactive operational bridge for our Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to help them translate technical solutions into tangible customer value, and drive the onboarding strategy for 15–20 international Customer Interaction Centre (CIC) stakeholders.

What You Bring

• Global Stakeholder Management: Experience working with multinational enterprise accounts and multi-market partner teams.

• Zendesk Expertise: Hands-on experience configuring and administering Zendesk for automated, scalable workflows.

Why Connected Cars?

• The opportunity to shape a vital support function during a critical phase of international growth.

• A collaborative culture valuing technical rigor and commercial ambition.

• Competitive salary, attractive pension, Friday bars, monthly social events, affordable lunch scheme, and unlimited office snacks.

Connected Cars is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

How to Apply

Please apply via LinkedIn with an up-to-date CV. A cover letter is optional, but feel free to add one if there is extra context you’d like to share.

Lead Designer for the world’s most impactful CPR training programs

We are looking for a hands-on Lead Designer who loves great Interaction Design, UX & UI craft, and can also set direction and bring an organisation with them.

At Laerdal, we develop CPR training solutions used by healthcare professionals and organisations around the world, with a mission to help save one million more lives each year by 2030.

We are seeking an exceptional Lead Designer to join our cross-functional product team in Copenhagen, working on the psycho-motor skills experience of RQI Provider and HeartCode Complete. These are cornerstone programs in the collaboration between Laerdal Medical and the American Heart Association, reaching millions of healthcare professionals across the globe.

This is an opportunity to shape experiences that ultimately help people become better prepared to save a life.

The design challenge goes well beyond screens. Learners move between digital instruction, software-guided practice, physical interaction with manikins and training stations, assessment, and certification. Your role is to make that entire experience coherent, intuitive, and effective.

About us

In Laerdal Copenhagen we are around 150 people developing best-in-class digital learning products. We hire people with grit and mission-driven hearts, and by joining us, you will become part of a unique and dynamic workplace that appreciates diversity, authenticity, ambition, and long-term, sustainable solutions.

We are a unique mix of talents, from medical doctors and learning specialists to designers, software engineers and 3D engineers, working with international partners to deliver effective learning solutions.

Some of what we offer

• A collaborative and diverse environment with lots of passion and energy. Our workplace is friendly and casual, located in an old warehouse at Islands Brygge.

• An outstanding teamwork culture driven by the mission of helping save lives.

• Fair compensation.

• Great opportunities for growth and personal development in a global organization

About you

You are an exceptional hands-on product designer who cares deeply about craft. You are equally comfortable defining an end-to-end learner experience, working through a complex interaction, and crafting the final UI that gets built.

You enjoy getting close to users, turning insight into ideas, and making those ideas tangible through flows, prototypes and high-quality screen designs. You have a strong eye for visual and interaction design, and you care about the details that make a product feel intuitive, coherent and polished.

At Lead level, we also expect you to look beyond the individual screen or feature. You can articulate a compelling design direction, bring Product, Engineering and other stakeholders with you, and use prototypes and customer evidence to move the team from discussion to experimentation and implementation faster.

This is a hands-on design role. You will be the designer creating the UX and UI for these products, not someone handing the work over to another designer.

About the role

On this cross-functional team, you will:

• Own the UX and UI design craft for RQI Provider and HeartCode Complete.

• Design the learner experience across digital interfaces, software-guided training and physical interaction with manikins and training stations.

• Create user flows, interaction models, wireframes, prototypes and polished, implementation-ready UI designs using Laerdal’s Life Design System.

• Work closely with Engineering throughout implementation, reviewing the built experience and ensuring that design quality and intent survive through release.

• Prototype early and often, putting tangible ideas in front of learners and customers rather than relying on presentations and specifications.

• Lead discovery and collaborate with a Design Researcher on research and usability testing to understand learner needs and validate solutions.

• Build a deep understanding of healthcare professionals and their CPR learning and certification journeys through direct engagement with learners, instructors and customers.

• Shape and communicate a strong design vision for the products, creating alignment across Product, Engineering, Educational Specialists and other stakeholders.

• Help the team shorten the cycle from idea to prototype, customer test, learning and release.

• Use AI-enabled workflows to accelerate exploration, prototyping and iteration.

• Travel to the US and other markets to observe training, test solutions and work directly with customers and partners.

Qualifications

• A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent hands-on UX, interaction and UI design craft in shipped products.

• Strong visual design skills and attention to detail, with the ability to take work all the way from rough concept to production-ready interface.

• Excellent prototyping skills, from quick experiments to realistic prototypes suitable for customer testing.

• Deep understanding of user-centered design, with demonstrated experience involving users throughout the design process.

• Experience designing complex digital products where software is part of a broader physical experience is a strong advantage.

• Ability to establish a product or experience design vision and translate it into concrete design work.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence Product, Engineering and senior stakeholders through customer evidence and tangible design proposals.

• An AI-first mindset toward your own design toolchain and cross-functional workflows in the team.

• Experience with healthcare, medical technology, learning products or connected devices is an advantage.

• Willingness to travel internationally, particularly to the US.
